objective: Align additional automatic rear-to-HQ commitments with fresh decreased/zero genuine military demand without touching accepted physical loads.

scope.records: This contract/flow, proportional feature evidence, C own records, final regenerated combined source/UI/button maps. No team/workflow/test changes.

authority.military: Existing resupply tick computes current personal/rack deficits minus couriers, actual local/HQ unreserved stock and accepted forward freight, once. Changed shortage including zero publishes through existing signal before any forward-plan early return.
authority.rear: Existing automatic request owns mutable requested target; manual quantities remain fixed. Rear reads request/manifest accounting only, not stock/time or force-refresh.
authority.physical: Existing Dispatch alone owns accepted manifest/cargo/claims/crew/site/return/cancellation. Reconciliation never edits them or delivered/credited.

arithmetic.uncredited_receipt: max(0, manifest.unloaded[type] - request.credited[manifest.id]); actual HQ receipt already participates in source coverage, so exclude this lag from every outstanding rear promise.
arithmetic.other_promises: For noncancelled other request: max(0, requested-delivered-uncredited_receipt). Cancelled departed nonterminal cargo contributes only max(0,cargo-unloaded), preserving existing physical rule. Completed rows contribute none.
arithmetic.accepted_floor: Current live accepted manifest contributes max(0,cargo-unloaded); missing owned record conservatively retains unresolved old remainder and stays blocked. Terminal record contributes no future cargo; uncredited actual receipts remain separately protected.
arithmetic.current_target: delivered + uncredited_receipt + max(uncovered, accepted_floor). Recompute only automatic mutable target; never lower below physical accounting.
arithmetic.coalescing: Unchanged publication coalesces at source; unchanged target performs no wake/notification. Existing explicit intent/receipt invalidation remains owned by existing events.

state_contract.Covered: Automatic row only, with no owned manifest remaining and no new uncovered work. cancelled false; explicit holds untouched. Existing visible reason is informational, not a red blocker.
state_contract.message: No additional automatic load currently needed; stock or existing commitments cover this request. Physical deliveries and recipient issue keep their own progress.
state_contract.guard: Owner rejects automatic Covered cancellation before any hold write; C disables corresponding Cancel and omits its reason only from global blockers.
state_contract.active: Accepted physical state/cancel stays intact even when new demand is zero. Missing manifest stays blocked. Terminal record first passes unchanged credit and clear path.
state_contract.resume: Later positive genuine uncovered quantity requeues Covered row normally without Resume; explicitly held/cancelled rows remain guarded. Manual rows never Covered.

acceptance: Fresh automatic need100 assessed30/0 limits new uncommitted commitments to30/0; illustrative arithmetic only, not a stock/threshold change.
Publish all changed shortages before Pending/Ready or failed forward-plan early return; forward admission ownership unchanged.
Actual received/accepted/manual/other commitments count exactly once, including unloaded-but-not-yet-credited lag.
Never rewrite accepted manifest or real delivered/credited counters; preserve manual fixed quantities, cancellation holds and safe return.
Covered feedback and command eligibility agree; later genuine need remains automatic; no new poll/timer/cache/stock grant/rate/threshold/HQ6000 change.
verification: Source review and required static metadata/whitespace maintenance only initially. No local engine, regression, broad scenario, failure injection, coverage matrix or benchmark.
